trials.intent: Advance horizontal position by direction multiplied by speed and clamp to the world bounds; preserve zero and negative directions.
With downward-positive coordinates, landing occurs when proposed y reaches or crosses ground zero; then reset vertical position and velocity. Preserve airborne motion.
Collect the star at most once after reaching its threshold, retaining a score between zero and one and terminal enemy-stop behavior.
